description:
3Red Partners, a proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, is seeking a C++ Developer to join the team. Our team has extensive, global experience in a wide variety of asset classes, risk management, and leading trading technologies. We focus our efforts on hiring extremely talented and motivated individuals to collaborate with each other and be on the forefront of leveraging technology and math to implement sophisticated trading strategies.

 The C++ Developer will have the opportunity to work in one of our offices focusing on all aspects of our high-frequency trading system. We are seeking a candidate that is looking for an opportunity to make a real impact, deliver value, and work within an experienced team.

 Your impact: 

 
 Implement, test, and deploy trading system features and tools according to business needs

 Monitor low latency trading system performance, ensure market data and research resource utilization issues are tracked, bugs are fixed and deployed appropriately

 Liaise internally with traders and developers to discuss performance optimizations, vet ideas and questions, refactor existing implementation, and monitor updates to the OS, libraries, and current internal frameworks

 Investigate improvements to the trading system; diagnose, debug, and address issues when needed

 
 Your skills: 

 
 A Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree with an emphasis in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field with more than 2 years of relevant work experience 

 Experience with coding languages, specifically, C++ (data structures) 

 Knowledge of third-party libraries (i.e. STL and Boost), linux environments, git

 Exceptional problem solving, written, and verbal communication skills

 
 Our perks: 

 3Red offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. In addition to a base salary, we offer performance-based bonuses, reflecting our commitment to rewarding excellence. We also provide comprehensive health benefits, a 401k plan, commuter and wellness reimbursements, as well as several learning and development perks. Our casual dress code, weekly lunches, and team events foster a welcoming and collaborative workplace culture. At our Chicago headquarters, we enhance the workday with fully stocked pantries offering snacks and drinks, a Zen Room for relaxation, and an environment designed to support productivity and well-being.

 The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $250,000, depending on qualifications, experience, and skills.

  

 3Red Partners does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party vendors. Any unsolicited resumes will become property of our team.
